entries.title: Grammarly says its AI agent can predict an A paper
entries.snippet:
Grammarly has introduced a suite of AI agents aimed at enhancing the writing experience for both students and educators, available through its new AI-native writing platform, Docs. These tools are free for Grammarly Free and Pro users. Designed to support student learning while promoting skill development, the AI agents offer advanced assistance such as an AI grader that predicts a potential grade based on course requirements and instructor data, and tailor suggestions to improve writing. Other tools include a proofreader agent, a citation finder, a paraphrasing agent, and a reader reaction predictor that forecasts how readers might respond.

For educators, Grammarly is rolling out AI and plagiarism detection tools that compare submissions to vast academic and online databases. However, these particular tools are currently limited to Grammarly Pro users. All AI agents will be extended to Enterprise and Education users later in the year, with additional tools to be announced. Grammarly emphasizes the importance of AI literacy in education and career readiness, aiming to help students develop skills for a future that includes working with AI.

entries.title: ACU 'robo-cheating' scandal: students falsely accused of using AI
entries.snippet: Australian Catholic University (ACU) has admitted to wrongfully accusing students of academic misconduct through the use of an unreliable AI detection tool, Turnitin Indicator. The university employed the tool to identify AI-generated student assignments, but many students were falsely accused without just cause, leading to lengthy and stressful investigation processes. One student reported that the ordeal took six months to resolve, delaying graduation and future academic opportunities. In March, ACU ceased using Turnitin Indicator due to its limited reliability, false negatives, and lack of transparency. About half of ACU’s 6,000 academic misconduct cases last year involved AI, but a quarter were dismissed, particularly when AI detection was the sole evidence. The burden of proving innocence largely fell on students. ACU has since improved its case management systems and investigation timelines. Other universities, such as Curtin University, also plan to stop using Turnitin Indicator, aiming to promote trust and fairness in assessments. Concerns about AI detection tools have also surfaced at other institutions, including Swinburne University.

entries.title: Turnitin's new "canvas" lets students use AI and show their work
entries.snippet: Turnitin has announced a new tool called "Clarity," aimed at addressing the growing impact of AI in education, especially with the rise of ChatGPT and AI features in mainstream software. Scheduled for release in the third quarter of 2025, Clarity is an online canvas that allows students to work on assignments using approved AI tools while demonstrating their creative process. The goal is to provide transparency for educators without overwhelming them with excessive data on every draft or edit. Turnitin acknowledges that despite advancements in AI, plagiarism rates have not declined. Clarity seeks to offer a structured environment for AI-assisted work, balancing innovation with academic integrity. This paid addition to Turnitin’s offerings comes as schools and educators navigate varied approaches to generative AI and explore ways it might also ease their workloads.

parts:
有。英文论文可以先用这些**免费或有免费额度**的 AI 率检测工具，但别把结果当成“判决书”。

| 工具 | 适合情况 | 免费限制/特点 |
|---|---|---|
| **QuillBot AI Detector** | 快速查英文段落、论文部分 | 免费、可显示 AI-generated / Human-written / AI-refined 分类；第三方测试称免费版每次约 1200 词、无需注册、次数不限。citeturn375457view0turn543928view1 |
| **Scribbr Free AI Detector** | 学生论文、essay 初筛 | 免费、无需注册；第三方测试称每次约 500 词、次数不限。citeturn543928view2 |
| **Paperpal AI Detector** | 更偏学术论文/英文科研写作 | 官方定位就是 “Essays and Papers”，会给句子级别提示，适合论文投稿前自查。citeturn375457view1 |
| **GPTZero** | 查长一点的英文内容、看高亮 | 可直接粘贴检测；页面显示未登录可检测到 10,000 characters，超过需免费账号。citeturn543928view0 |
| **Sapling AI Detector** | 备用交叉检查 | 免费、无需注册，但第三方测试准确率低于 QuillBot / Scribbr。citeturn543928view2 |

**我建议的用法：**  
先用 **QuillBot + Scribbr/Paperpal** 交叉检测。不要整篇一次性全丢进去，最好按 **Abstract、Introduction、Literature Review、Methodology、Discussion** 分段检测，这样更容易找出被标高的部分。

**注意：Turnitin 的 AI 检测一般不是给学生免费直接用的。** 官方说它的 AI checker 是集成在教育机构/教师使用的产品和 LMS 流程里，所以网上那些写着 “Free Turnitin AI Detector” 的站点要小心，很多不是 Turnitin 官方。citeturn375457view4

最重要的一点：**AI 检测器会误判。** Scribbr 的测试也说明 AI 检测器不能 100% 准确，混合人写+AI修改、专业领域文本、改写过的文本都更难判断；结果只能作为参考，不应作为学术诚信的唯一证据。citeturn375457view3
